answer: Reaching the delta of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, revoked by a single upheld challenge, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. The voyage is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the karst. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
